decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Following approval for change of use from offices together with extensions and alterations to provide nine 2 - bedroomed and one 1 - bedroomed flat, including the following: (a) Demolition of existing single storey side extension and fire  escape, timber shed at rear and brick store on northwestern boundary. (b) Alterations to parking area to provide five off-street parking spaces, relocated access, new landscaping, and garden arear at rear. (c) Relocation of shed and erection of conservatory. (d) Enlargement of roof of single storey rear addition and insertion of dormer windows, plus single storey rear extension. (e)  Erection of 2-storey side extension incorporating roof accommodation AMENDED PLANS RECEIVED 09-04-2003 - details submitted pursuant to Condition 3 (hard and soft landscape works) of approved planning permission ref 00527/41-43/P13 dated 29/09/2003.
